If the current and voltage is given by the equation  
 
 
i(t) = 15 sin (100t – 53.13o) 
 
 
v(t) = 7.5 sin (100t + 30o) 
 
The element connected in circuit is  
 
(a) R 
(b) L 
 
(c) C 
(d) None of these
explanation: Practice Question from Network Theory DPP-29 (Phasor Diagram).
